incident.message: Unhealthy: Readiness probe failed: Get "http://10.0.47.228:8080/ready": dial tcp 10.0.47.228:8080: connect: connection refused

classification.rationale: Readiness probe failed due to connection refused error when reaching the container's health check endpoint, indicating a network connectivity issue.

diagnosis.root_cause: The new ReplicaSet pod (shop-3b87bd-cc79cdffd-2bnkm) from a rolling update is persistently failing its readiness probe because the application it runs does not implement the /ready HTTP endpoint — every probe attempt returns HTTP 404. The web server starts and listens on port 8080 successfully, but the path does not exist in this version of the code. The rolling update is stuck: the old pod (shop-3b87bd-7b79b4d9c-b6fn9) remains Ready while the new pod never becomes Ready.

evidence.value: code 404, message File not found (repeated every 10s)
Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404
Readiness probe failed: Get "http://10.0.47.228:8080/ready": dial tcp 10.0.47.228:8080: connect: connection refused
[] — no NetworkPolicies present, network blocking ruled out

proposal.rationale: The new pod's application code (ReplicaSet shop-3b87bd-cc79cdffd) does not expose the /ready HTTP endpoint that the readiness probe expects. This is not fixable via a Service selector, targetPort, or NetworkPolicy change — those are all within spec. A human needs to: (1) inspect the container image/tag used by ReplicaSet cc79cdffd vs the working 7b79b4d9c to identify what changed; (2) either roll back the Deployment to the previous image, or fix the application code to serve GET /ready with a 2xx status code and re-deploy.
proposal.risk: Until resolved, the rolling update remains stuck. Traffic continues to be served by the old ready pod (shop-3b87bd-7b79b4d9c-b6fn9), so end-user impact is currently limited, but the Deployment will not complete its rollout.
proposal.delivery: Apply as a pull request against /gitops after a human approves it. The agent does not change the cluster.
